title: World Happiness Report
definition: The World Happiness Report is a landmark publication of global data that ranks countries by how happy their citizens perceive themselves to be, using extensive survey metrics and institutional indicators.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims regarding publishing agencies, ranking indices, and performance parameters, and utilized in Mains GS-2 and GS-3 for arguments on inclusive growth, human development, and well-being beyond GDP.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of World Happiness Report.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Human Development Index and Economic Development vs. Growth
